title: Separate hard constraints from creative territory
problem: Undifferentiated instructions cause agents either to violate requirements or to over-constrain useful exploration.

alternatives.outcome: Rejected because requirement priority and creative freedom remain ambiguous.

decision: Every design contract and compiled context package identifies non-negotiable constraints separately from bounded creative opportunities.
risks: Teams may incorrectly label subjective preference as a hard constraint.
exceptions: Exploratory studies may contain no production hard constraints beyond safety and scope.
implementation: Represent both collections in the v0.1 contract schemas.
validation: Schema examples must include and validate both collections.
reviewTriggers: Benchmark evidence shows the distinction reduces output quality or is misunderstood.
